name: @decompflow/desktop
description: DecompFlow Studio - Autonomous AI Reverse Engineering & Feature Reconstruction Desktop Application
author: dropt1mx0 <dropt1m@users.noreply.github.com>

scripts.build:main: esbuild src/main/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/main/index.js --external:electron --external:@decompflow/core --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run copy:assets
scripts.dev: npm run build:main && npm run build:preload && npm run copy:assets && electron dist/main/index.js --no-sandbox --no-zygote --disable-gpu
